continuity: Go Se-won is held in a special detention center under mana suppression while cooperating with the investigation and interrogation.
Go Se-won has a daughter and considers protecting his family the most important result of his break with Ares Guild.
A second secret area exists inside Area A of the Ares Guild headquarters, but its location, access method, and contents remain unknown.
Go Se-won has revealed the hidden area's existence to Jin and asked him to search for it.
plot: Jin visits Go Se-won in the heavily guarded special detention center. The former Ares Head of Security accepts responsibility for his choice to break with the Guild, has no regrets, and says protecting his family made the losses worthwhile.

Go Se-won reveals that another secret area is hidden within Area A of the Ares Guild headquarters. Only Lee Jungryong and Go Jun were permitted to enter it; Go Se-won does not know its location, access method, or contents, and asks Jin to find it before the government investigation team discovers it.

Jin remains booked without detention; the main allegation concerns injuries to more than five hundred casualties, while self-defense is likely to be recognized.
